mascot.expected: src/assets/brand/paulex-mascot.svg (or .png, square, the official file as supplied)
mascot.note: The official Paulex mascot (a minimal character in a navy circle) was not supplied to the repository. It is never drawn here: the wordmark stands alone until the file is added, and BrandMark.astro then shows it beside the wordmark.

icons.what: A white capital P in Google Sans Flex (700) on the navy: a typographic stand-in, not a mark, until the official mascot exists. Generated once with the site's own font file; replace by icons derived from the mascot.
